finding.expected: The publication gate must deterministically accept and validate canonical successful REMEDIATION lineage as well as PRIMARY lineage, bind the decision RUN_ID and exact reviewed/result head through the operation-appropriate canonical structure, and publish exactly the reviewed candidate when all existing gates pass. Preserve all fail-closed behavior, review/source separation, exact-SHA CAS protection, no retry or fallback, and do not weaken PRIMARY lineage validation. Add deterministic regression coverage proving a PASS-reviewed successful REMEDIATION candidate can publish while malformed or mismatched remediation lineage cannot.
finding.issue: The live repository-native publication attempt for the canonical PASS decision on RUN-063-006 reached the event-bound publication gate successfully, but the gate rejected the valid successful REMEDIATION artifacts with "RUN-ID mismatch between decision ref and RUN". publication.py assumes the transported run.json is always a PRIMARY RUN with run_id at the top level, while canonical successful REMEDIATION artifacts wrap the operational RUN under execution.run. As a result, a valid PASS-reviewed remediation candidate cannot be published even though the same TASK requires publication after canonical semantic PASS regardless of whether the successful candidate came from PRIMARY or narrow correction lineage.
